rationale: S-0033-06 proposes a reusable DSI-objective evaluation-harness library separating scoring from the optimiser loop. The t0033 optimiser remains deferred per brainstorm 9 / brainstorm 10; the harness library is a useful infrastructure investment but is not on the from-scratch wave's critical path. Reprioritising from high to medium pending the t0033 optimiser revival.
